proposals.action_title: Publish first 40-page niche coloring book on Amazon KDP
proposals.why_this_works_now: The produce_coloring_book pipeline is ready. Using Runware PAYG (approx. $0.05 for 40 high-quality FLUX-schnell line art images) bypasses current AI limits and delivers retail-grade assets instantly.
proposals.first_action_today: Run the produce_coloring_book workflow via GitHub Actions using the Runware API key to generate the 40 pages and the cover.

proposals.action_title: Bulk-upload 50 text-based and minimal vector designs to Redbubble
proposals.why_this_works_now: Redbubble is registered but empty. Using the existing produce_literal_idioms or produce_quotes_minimal pipelines allows instant PNG generation that can be bulk-uploaded using Redbubble's CSV-like automation or quick-upload templates.
proposals.first_action_today: Generate 50 transparent PNG quote designs via Termux using python-pillow, and upload them to Redbubble targeting trending French/English idioms.

proposals.action_title: Upload 5 functional parametric 3D models on Cults3D
proposals.why_this_works_now: Cults3D is planned. Functional 3D prints (drawer organizers, cable management, gridfinity-compatible models) sell consistently to 3D printing enthusiasts. The produce_stl_parametric pipeline can programmatically output these STL files.
proposals.first_action_today: Activate Cults3D account, generate 5 STL variations of modular desk organizers using OpenSCAD via Termux/Actions, and price them at 1.99 EUR each.

proposals.action_title: Publish 2D pixel-art/icon asset packs on itch.io for indie developers
proposals.why_this_works_now: Indie developers constantly buy low-cost asset packs (UI, items, tilesets). Using FLUX via Together AI (free tier) or Runware to generate a pack of 100 RPG icons has zero overhead and targets a highly transactional audience on itch.io.
proposals.first_action_today: Execute the produce_gamedev_asset_pack pipeline to generate 100 fantasy item icons, package them in a ZIP with a license text, and publish on itch.io for $2.99.

proposals.action_title: Launch 5 hyper-niche low-content logbooks on Amazon KDP
proposals.why_this_works_now: Low-content interiors (chess scorebooks, recipe logs, garden planning sheets) require no complex AI generation. Utilizing the produce_lowcontent_kdp pipeline generates print-ready PDFs in seconds, targeting long-tail Amazon search queries.
proposals.first_action_today: Generate a 'French Wine Tasting Journal' PDF interior and minimal cover, then publish it on KDP priced at 6.99 EUR.

proposals.action_title: Redirect organic traffic using an automated Pinterest Pin scheduler
proposals.why_this_works_now: Organic reach on Etsy/KDP takes time. Automatically generating Pinterest Pins featuring mockups of the newly uploaded coloring books or Cults3D models, and scheduling them daily via GitHub Actions, drives high-intent traffic directly to the product pages.
proposals.first_action_today: Create a free Pinterest Business account and set up a basic script in Termux to generate and push 3 daily image pins with direct links to his Amazon KDP author page.
